histology: high-grade serous carcinoma (tubo-ovarian / primary peritoneal; WT1+, PAX8+, SOX17+, CK7+)

biomarkers.name: TP53 (p53 IHC surrogate)
biomarkers.value: mutated (inferred) — p53 diffuse strong nuclear overexpression in >80% of tumor cells
biomarkers.decision_resolution: p53 IHC abnormal pattern is an accepted surrogate for a TP53 mutation; tumor NGS would formally confirm the variant but is not required to define HGSC biology.

biomarkers.name: BRCA1/2 (germline)
biomarkers.value: wild-type — no pathogenic or likely-pathogenic variant
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Germline NGS; resolves hereditary BRCA status but does NOT resolve somatic BRCA or tumor HRD.

biomarkers.name: HRD / genomic instability (tumor)
biomarkers.method: tumor NGS (somatic panel ordered, result not returned)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Genomic-instability/HRD score (e.g. Myriad MyChoice GIS >=42 or equivalent) and/or somatic BRCA1/2 from tumor NGS; gates PARP-inhibitor maintenance eligibility and magnitude of benefit.

biomarkers.name: Somatic BRCA1/2 (tumor)
biomarkers.method: tumor NGS (somatic panel ordered, result not returned)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Tumor NGS variant call; somatic BRCA reversion/mutation status further refines PARP-inhibitor expectation independent of germline.

biomarkers.name: MSI / MMR
biomarkers.decision_resolution: MSI-high or dMMR would open tumor-agnostic checkpoint-inhibitor eligibility; not available.

biomarkers.name: ER
biomarkers.value: positive (~80% of tumor nuclei, weak-moderate intensity)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: IHC ER positivity supports an endocrine-therapy rationale in HGSC; magnitude tempered by PR-negativity.

biomarkers.name: HER2
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Does not meet HER2-expression threshold for trastuzumab-deruxtecan; forecloses that HER2-directed ADC on current specimen.

biomarkers.name: FOLR1 (folate receptor alpha)
biomarkers.value: negative (<75% of cells at moderate/strong membranous intensity)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: FRalpha >=75% (PS2+) required for mirvetuximab soravtansine; below threshold, so that ADC is out of scope on current specimen.

biomarkers.name: CA-125
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Response/monitoring marker, not a therapeutic target.

biomarkers.name: Signatera ctDNA (MRD)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Molecular-residual-disease marker; informs relapse risk and maintenance intensity, not target selection.

prior_therapies.regimen: Neoadjuvant carboplatin + paclitaxel + bevacizumab with GEN-1 (IMNN-01), an investigational IL-12 immunogene therapy, x4 cycles

current_therapy: Post-interval-debulking carboplatin + paclitaxel + GEN-1 (IMNN-01), an investigational IL-12 immunogene therapy; status-post interval radical tumor-reductive surgery (TAH/BSO + omentectomy + bilateral ureterolysis) with R0 resection.

targetable_features.feature: HRD / homologous-recombination status (somatic BRCA + genomic-instability score) — PENDING
targetable_features.rationale: The single highest-value decision point for this newly-diagnosed, platinum-responsive, R0 Stage IIIc HGSC. Germline BRCA is wild-type but somatic BRCA and a tumor HRD/genomic-instability score are not yet resulted; they gate PARP-inhibitor maintenance (e.g. niraparib regardless of HRD; olaparib +/- bevacizumab in HRD-positive). The deep platinum response is consistent with, but not diagnostic of, HRD. Treat the HRD/somatic-BRCA assay as the rank-1 shared workup.

Patient is already receiving bevacizumab; VEGF is an established actionable maintenance axis in advanced HGSC (bevacizumab maintenance; combinable with PARP inhibitor in HRD-positive disease). In scope for maintenance strategy.

ER-positive HGSC provides a low-toxicity endocrine-therapy rationale (e.g. aromatase inhibition) as a maintenance or later-line option, attractive given the patient's age and stated preference for low-burden, oral therapy. PR-negativity tempers expected magnitude.
Active investigational IL-12 immunogene therapy (GEN-1 / IMNN-01); relevant to immunotherapy-combination reasoning and to the board's on-study context, though not a standard-of-care target.
